attchmntText: Gammon India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of extract of financial results of quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.
voiceSummary: Gammon India Limited disclosed unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 6th November 2026. The company reported a standalone loss after tax of 316.78 crores for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, the standalone loss after tax was 605.55 crores. Consolidated loss after tax for the quarter was 365.51 crores, and 738.26 crores for the half year. Paid-up equity share capital remains at 74.11 crores with a face value of 2 rupees per equity share. Basic and diluted earnings per share for the quarter were negative 8.59 rupees. The results were published in The Free Press Journal and Navshak on 7th November 2026.

attchmntText: Gammon India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
